title: A riding habit, and the second pommel on the 1904 side saddle
items: Your person can now wear a riding habit in 1835 and 1904: pick it under Settings, You, as her dress. It is a dark green habit with a tall black hat in 1835, and a navy habit with a low black hard hat in 1904.
The 1904 side saddle now has its second pommel, the leaping head, curving down over her left thigh. She sits a little differently in 1904 so it clears her leg.
